methods.label: Compare corresponding decimal places
methods.explanation: All five numbers have integer part \(0\) and tenths digit \(9\), so compare their hundredths digits next. The number \(0.99\) has hundredths digit \(9\), while every other choice has hundredths digit \(0\), writing \(0.9\) as \(0.90\) when needed. Therefore the largest number is \(0.99\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
